limitations: Single-variant fetch: one geography, one device profile, no logged-in state, no cookie consent accepted. Personalization and geo/consent-gated content are not observed.
Lab proxy, not field data: latency and Core Web Vitals appear as risk factors measured once, not real-user metrics.
Network-dependent checks (sameAs resolvability, broken links) reflect what was reachable at audit time and are excluded from the byte-for-byte determinism guarantee.

findings.title: robots.txt blocks AI citation crawlers from the homepage
findings.evidence: 2/11 citation bots Disallowed for homepage http://127.0.0.1:45377/index.html: ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot. Resolved verdicts: Amazonbot=Allow; Applebot=Allow; Bingbot=Allow; ChatGPT-User=DISALLOW; Claude-SearchBot=Allow; Claude-User=Allow; DuckDuckBot=Allow; Googlebot=Allow; OAI-SearchBot=Allow; Perplexity-User=Allow; PerplexityBot=DISALLOW
findings.mechanism: AI assistants retrieve live pages via citation crawlers; a Disallow for one of these bots removes the brand from that assistant's answers.

suggested_action.summary: Remove or narrow the Disallow rules for these citation/search bots in robots.txt (ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot). Keep training-only opt-outs if desired, but allow the crawlers that power AI answers to reach the homepage.
suggested_action.mechanism: AI assistants retrieve live pages via citation crawlers; a Disallow for one of these bots removes the brand from that assistant's answers.

findings.title: noindex directive on content pages
findings.evidence: 1/5 content pages carry a noindex directive: http://127.0.0.1:45377/services.html (meta name=robots content='noindex, nofollow')
findings.mechanism: A noindex directive instructs indexing engines to exclude the page, so it cannot surface as a citation source even if crawling is allowed.

suggested_action.summary: Remove the noindex directive (meta tag or X-Robots-Tag header) from pages you want cited. noindex tells search/citation engines to drop the page from their index entirely.
suggested_action.mechanism: A noindex directive instructs indexing engines to exclude the page, so it cannot surface as a citation source even if crawling is allowed.

findings.title: Site is served over plain HTTP
findings.evidence: Origin http://127.0.0.1:45377 declares no HTTPS (no https canonical, og:url, or sitemap); traffic is unencrypted and browsers mark it 'Not secure'.
findings.mechanism: Non-HTTPS pages are flagged insecure, blocked from modern APIs, and ranked down; visitors distrust and abandon them.

suggested_action.summary: Obtain a TLS certificate and redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS.
suggested_action.mechanism: Non-HTTPS pages are flagged insecure, blocked from modern APIs, and ranked down; visitors distrust and abandon them.

findings.title: No Organization entity anchor in JSON-LD
findings.evidence: No Organization/LocalBusiness/Corporation JSON-LD node on any sampled page (0/5 pages). Engines have no machine-readable brand node to anchor to.
findings.mechanism: AI engines resolve the brand string to a knowledge-graph node BEFORE evaluating page content; with no stable anchor, entity consolidation and knowledge-panel eligibility never begin.

suggested_action.summary: Add one Organization JSON-LD node with a stable @id, plus name, url and logo, on the homepage (and reference it site-wide).
suggested_action.mechanism: AI engines resolve the brand string to a knowledge-graph node BEFORE evaluating page content; with no stable anchor, entity consolidation and knowledge-panel eligibility never begin.

findings.title: Missing rel=canonical
findings.evidence: 5/5 pages have no rel=canonical link (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:45377/faq.html).
findings.mechanism: Without a canonical, engines may index a duplicate URL and attribute the fact to the wrong page, splitting authority.

suggested_action.summary: Add a self-referential absolute rel=canonical to each key page.
suggested_action.mechanism: Without a canonical, engines may index a duplicate URL and attribute the fact to the wrong page, splitting authority.

findings.title: Media without reserved space and fonts without font-display cause layout shift
findings.evidence: 6 /
findings.mechanism: Media that loads without reserved dimensions and late-swapping fonts reflow the page (Cumulative Layout Shift), which frustrates readers and mis-taps.

suggested_action.summary: Set width/height (or CSS aspect-ratio) on media so space is reserved before load, and add font-display: swap to @font-face rules.
suggested_action.mechanism: Media that loads without reserved dimensions and late-swapping fonts reflow the page (Cumulative Layout Shift), which frustrates readers and mis-taps.

findings.title: Non-200 final status on sampled URLs
findings.evidence: 1/6 sampled URLs return a non-200 final status: http://127.0.0.1:45377/archives.html -> HTTP 404 (not_found)
findings.mechanism: A crawler that hits a non-200 final response gets no content to index or cite from that URL.

suggested_action.summary: Investigate and restore 200 responses, or remove the dead links pointing here.
suggested_action.mechanism: A crawler that hits a non-200 final response gets no content to index or cite from that URL.

findings.title: Images ship at one size and load eagerly below the fold
findings.evidence: 2 below-fold content images missing loading=lazy across 2/5 pages. (Hero/first image intentionally excluded.)
findings.mechanism: Oversized single-resolution images waste bandwidth and delay paint; eager below-fold images compete with above-fold content for the network.

suggested_action.summary: Add srcset/<picture> responsive variants to large images and loading=lazy to below-fold content images; leave the hero/LCP image eager.
suggested_action.mechanism: Oversized single-resolution images waste bandwidth and delay paint; eager below-fold images compete with above-fold content for the network.

findings.title: No off-site identity surface found
findings.evidence: No sameAs, no footer/social profile links, and no Wikipedia/Wikidata link on any of the 5 sampled pages.
findings.mechanism: The large majority of AI brand mentions are sourced from third-party pages; with zero off-site surface there is structurally little for an engine to cite.

suggested_action.summary: Establish and link off-site identity surfaces (social profiles, Crunchbase, Wikidata/Wikipedia) and mirror them in Organization.sameAs.
suggested_action.mechanism: The large majority of AI brand mentions are sourced from third-party pages; with zero off-site surface there is structurally little for an engine to cite.

findings.title: Missing or generic <title>
findings.evidence: 4/5 pages have a missing/generic title (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:45377/index.html: "home").
findings.mechanism: The title is the strongest orientation signal an extractor has for what fact the page answers; a generic title leaves it guessing.

suggested_action.summary: Give each page a specific, descriptive <title> naming the page's subject.
suggested_action.mechanism: The title is the strongest orientation signal an extractor has for what fact the page answers; a generic title leaves it guessing.

findings.title: <html> missing lang attribute
findings.evidence: 4/5 pages have an <html> element with no lang attribute (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:45377/faq.html).
findings.mechanism: The lang attribute tells machines which language the fact is written in; its absence hurts correct interpretation and localization.

suggested_action.summary: Set a lang attribute on <html> (e.g. lang="en").
suggested_action.mechanism: The lang attribute tells machines which language the fact is written in; its absence hurts correct interpretation and localization.

findings.title: Missing landmarks, skip link, or a clear above-fold value proposition
findings.evidence: no skip-to-content link on 5/5 pages; no clear above-fold value prop (H1 + descriptive paragraph) on 1/5 pages. Heuristic; value-prop baked into a hero image is not detected.
findings.mechanism: Landmarks and skip links aid keyboard/screen-reader navigation; a clear above-fold value prop tells arrivals they're in the right place, reducing bounce.

suggested_action.summary: Wrap primary content in <main>, add a skip-to-content link, and lead with an H1 plus a one-line description of what the page offers.
suggested_action.mechanism: Landmarks and skip links aid keyboard/screen-reader navigation; a clear above-fold value prop tells arrivals they're in the right place, reducing bounce.

findings.title: Non-sequential heading levels
findings.evidence: 3/5 pages skip heading levels (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:45377/index.html jumps h1->h4).
findings.mechanism: Level jumps break the document outline machines build to locate a fact within a section.

suggested_action.summary: Keep headings sequential (no skipping levels) so the outline parses cleanly.
suggested_action.mechanism: Level jumps break the document outline machines build to locate a fact within a section.

findings.title: Missing meta description
findings.evidence: 4/5 pages have no meta description (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:45377/faq.html).
findings.mechanism: A meta description gives extractors a ready-made summary snippet; its absence is a minor, recoverable gap.

suggested_action.summary: Add a concise meta description summarizing the page (soft advisory).
suggested_action.mechanism: A meta description gives extractors a ready-made summary snippet; its absence is a minor, recoverable gap.
